declared: 2026-11-08, before the frozen rustc 1.98.0 oracle of these exact bytes and before any candidate run of these bytes. The shapes reduce census 10's lookahead record at core's error.rs:588 (`#[repr(transparent)] pub struct Request<'a>(Tagged<dyn Erased<'a> + 'a>);`, "trait object has no fixed layout" in the crate-wide layout pass). Analysis-only drafts of the request, plain request and tuple tail shapes (obj/parallel/census-batch9/repro/layout-*.rs) were run through the census 10 pin and, for the request shapes, rustc 1.98.0 before this declaration, so those three are a regression record of that exploration; the others were not run by anyone. Each outcome follows the stated rule (a trait object, like a slice or str, has no fixed layout, so a declaration whose last field is or ends in one has no static layout to demand and is accepted; a trait object that is not the last field of a struct, or is an enum variant field, is still not sized and is rejected)

amendments.amended: 2026-11-08, after the first frozen rustc 1.98.0 oracle and before any candidate run of either the original or the amended bytes
amendments.reason: rustc 1.98.0 rejected three controls declared to be accepted (tuple-tail, transparent-tail and slice-tail) with `requires copy lang_item` before checking their layouts, because the no_core prefix lacked it. Every file gains the minimal `Clone` and `Copy` lang items of the const-bound-projections prefix after `Sized`. No declaration body or declared outcome changes.

amendments.amended: 2026-11-08, after the second frozen rustc 1.98.0 oracle and before any candidate run of any of these bytes
amendments.reason: the first amendment added `Clone` without the `legacy_receiver` lang item its `&self` receiver needs, so rustc 1.98.0 rejected all six controls declared to be accepted with `requires legacy_receiver lang_item`. Every file gains the minimal `LegacyReceiver` declaration and its two reference impls before `Clone`, so lines 3 to 54 are exactly those of the const-bound-projections prefix. No declaration body or declared outcome changes.
